name: Missing Signer Authorization
description: Sensitive instruction executes without verifying transaction signer authorization.

name: Account Data Matching
insecure_pattern: Token account deserialized without verifying owner relationship
description: Program accepts account data without validating that the signer owns the supplied account.

name: Missing Owner Check
insecure_pattern: Account data trusted without verifying program ownership
secure_pattern: Explicit owner validation against SPL Token Program
description: Program accepts attacker-controlled account data because account ownership is not validated.

name: Type Cosplay
insecure_pattern: Account data deserialized into an expected type without verifying account discriminator
description: Attacker supplies a different account type with a compatible memory layout, causing the program to interpret malicious data as a trusted account.
